comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 42.9% similarity to Palustrin-2c. Activity: Active against Gram+ M. luteus (MIC 0.125 uM), B. subtilis (0.062 uM), B. licheniformis (0.125 uM), S. aureus 209P (2 uM), S. aureus ATCC 29213 (2 uM), Rhodococcus sp. (0.125 uM), Gram- bacteria E. coli BL21 (DE3) (MIC 2 uM), E. coli ML-35p (MIC 16 uM), A. baumannii (MIC 32 uM), P. aeruginosa PAO1 (32 uM). At 16 uM, it didn't inhibit B-megaterium. Antimicrobial robustness: The activity is salt-sensitive. Structure: You can rotate, zoom, and view the 3D structure here in the PDB. Updated 3/2020; 4/2025
reference_text: Mar Drugs. 2018 Oct 23;16(11). pii: E401. doi: 10.3390/md16110401. PubMed
